clusters.headline: South Sudan: South Sudan's First Elections Won't Be Perfect - but Another Delay Could Be Even Riskier
clusters.summary: [The Conversation Africa] South Sudan is expected to hold an election on 22 December 2026, the first in the country's history. It's already been postponed twice, in 2022 and 2024.

clusters.summary: [New Zimbabwe] FORMER Citizens Coalition for Change (CCC) leader Nelson Chamisa has dismissed claims that he received money from Zanu PF to silence him on the controversial Constitutional Amendment Bill (CAB3), which was recently signed into law.

clusters.headline: Burundi: 'A Doctor Told Me to Buy My Coffin' - How Eric Turned an HIV Diagnosis Into Activism
